title: MCP server manifest (C6)
description: Generated by the starter at build time (target/mcp-manifest.json), served at GET /mcp-manifest (requires C2) and registered with PUT /admin/v1/registry/servers/{serverId} (C5). Rules checked in addition to this schema (see README, 'Reguły semantyczne'): serverId == 'mcp-' + system; tool names unique; every resourceRefs[].type and resourceTypes[].parent is declared in resourceTypes; resourceTypes[].type unique; definition.name == name; definition.inputSchema has no confirmation_code; definitionHash recomputed from definition and the entry equals the declared one (CC-005).

internalUrl.description: Informational. The gateway takes serverId -> system/internalUrl only from its own configuration and rejects a manifest that disagrees (C5).

attributes.description: Attributes the server's resolver fills from the system (Cedar entity attributes).

argument.description: Name of a top-level argument of the tool's inputSchema whose value is a resource id (string or array of strings).

ToolEntry.description: Manifest entry of one tool. Every tool that accepts a resource identifier MUST declare resourceRefs (C6).

ToolEntryFields.description: Fields of a manifest tool entry, open for composition (used by the gateway registry API).

resourceRefs.description: Always present; an empty array when the tool takes no resource identifier (one canonical form for definitionHash).

definitionHash.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of definition + risk, action, resourceRefs + system, credential (CC-004, CC-005). Receivers recompute it.

McpToolDefinition.description: Full MCP tool definition as returned by tools/list (CC-005). Input of definitionHash together with risk, action, resourceRefs and the server fields system and credential.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the arguments. Must not declare confirmation_code (reserved for the gateway, C11).
